hints: A run passes the code grader only as a true done: the status is done and the checks passed.
Count each run once for passes. For tasks, a task passes at least once when any of its trials passes, and passes every time when all of them do.
passes sums the runs where status is done and passed is True. Group the trials by task, then count the groups with any True and the groups with all True.
title: Run an eval with a code grader over seeded trials
